messages:
Jordan: Heads up — PR #24218 is stuck on integration CI (mac/e2e matrix). Getting repeated ecr/cache misses. Should we rebase now or wait for the cache backfill? Target is to land before Friday deploy freeze.
Maria: Link? and short summary of failing job pls.
Jordan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/24218
Jordan: Failing log (snippet):
```
error: failed to fetch layer sha256:abc123: cache miss from ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
Test suite: mac-e2e-serial › setup › launch browser - timed out after 30000ms
```

CI Bot: Job failed: mac-e2e-serial (runner-12). Retry available: 2. Rerun command: `/ci rerun 24218 mac-e2e-serial`

Alex: I can try warming the ECR cache (kick a build on a fresh runner) — gives a better chance than immediate rebase. If it's still flakey after that, rebase+retest.
Sam: Is this blocking other PRs or just this one?
Jordan: Blocks PR #24222 and #24240 (depend on the feature branch). Those are small but need this merged before the freeze to avoid manual canary juggling.
Alex: If Jordan rebases onto main, I can give a quick review and approve once CI is green. If you want me to warm cache now, say the word.
Maria: Reminder: deploy freeze starts Fri 18:00 UTC. Prefer to have merges done by Thu EOD for rollback headroom. If it's risky, plan a canary early Thu.
Jordan: Ok I'll attempt a rebase tonight and kick a cache-warm first thing in the morning. Ping me if CI still flakes and I'll rebase during the Thursday rebase window.
Alex: :thumbsup: I can queue the warm-up at 08:00 UTC and monitor. Will post job id here.
CI Bot: Warm-up job queued: build-5667 (warming ECR and runner pool). Estimated ~10m.
Jordan: Thanks — will rebase if build-5667 doesn't clear the failure. Asking for eyes for a quick follow review tomorrow morning.
Maria: Sounds good. @Alex please @Jordan once you see green and run `/ci rerun` if needed.

Alex: Will do. Good luck — let us know if you need a hand with the rebase conflict resolution.
Sam: If we get blocked, consider reverting a non-blocking change off the branch to make the merge smaller, that helped earlier this month.
Jordan: Noted. I'll update the PR with the plan and ETA after the warm-up completes.
Maria: Thanks team :)
